items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: But I recorded and taught him what he did -- and that was my first studio job.

ctx.x: And the object of this was this little boy was supposed to be a drummer and he was supposed to play. He was about 7 years old. Billy Lee. And he was supposed to close the show or something, as a drummer -- and I had to
go out and teach him to play. But I recorded and taught him what he did -- and that was my first studio job.
You say you recorded, you mean it was your drumming on the soundtrack.
